text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm proposing a telemetry gate for the new rollout flag `rollout_telemetry_gate_v1`. Before we widen beyond the 5% pilot in APAC we want automated checks on: error-rate delta, tail latency (p95/p99), and quality regression signal from eval prompts.

alex_k: sounds good. what windows are we using for the deltas? 5m or 1h?

maria: thinking two windows: 5m for immediate safety, 1h for stability. thresholds: error-rate +0.5% absolute and p99 +200ms as hard aborts.

jamal: +1. also recommend a canary A/B bucket for 10k users to capture semantic regressions. we should tie the quality metric to an eval set of 200 prompts (same as CI eval).

elaine: can we surface the gate status in the console? product wants a single "telemetry gate" card per rollout with green/yellow/red states + links.

product-lead: yup — launch criteria we discussed last week still apply but add: (1) telemetry gate green for 24h at 10% traffic, (2) no new customer-facing incidents, (3) on-call signoff once logs & traces reviewed. I'll own the final go/no-go.

maria: putting a quick config sketch here. this will be attached to the flag as a pre-commit gate.

```
flag: rollout_telemetry_gate_v1
strategy:
  - stage: pilot
    pct: 5
    telemetry_checks:
      - name: error_rate_delta
        window: 5m
        threshold: 0.5
        action: abort
      - name: p99_latency
        window: 1h
        threshold_ms: 200
        action: abort
      - name: eval_quality_delta
        window: 1h
        threshold: -0.02
        action: pause
```

alex_k: nice. who implements the telemetry rule? infra or eng-ml?

jamal: infra can wire the alerting hooks, eng-ml will provide the eval harness + dataset. i'll coordinate.

elaine: for regional rollouts we need to add fallback routing: EU should fall back to model-v1-small if the gate trips, not to a different region (data residency).

maria: good call. fallback policy for region-specific rollouts: prefer local compatible variant -> degrade quantization -> last resort route to hosted fallback. need to add to runbook.

sre-bot: [automated] canary smoke in eu-west-1: 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z — latency p95=120ms, p99=210ms, error_rate=0.12% — status: WARNING (p99 above threshold)

jamal: saw the bot. that's in the warning zone — can someone pull traces?

alex_k: grabbing traces now. root cause looks like a hot KV shard on fe-3. resharding in progress.

maria: action items: (1) jamal to own eval harness run and verify quality delta (2) infra to add telemetry checks to the flag API (3) product to add gate card in console + runbook link (4) SRE to confirm fallback mapping and automation.

product-lead: timeline: aim for 10% EU in 48 hours if gate is green. otherwise halt and triage. please @me on any red/abort states.

elaine: will add runbook snippets to the rollout doc and tag on-call.

maria: thanks all. i'll update the feature flag PR with the YAML and the gating checklist. ping me if you want edit access. :thumbsup:
